newsitem.title: MEXICO: Four killed in Mexico bus plunge.
newsitem.headline: Four killed in Mexico bus plunge.

text.p: Four farm workers were killed and 15 injured when a bus plunged into a stream in the northern Mexican state of Sinaloa early on Thursday, officials said.
They said excess speed and overloading caused the crash, near the city of Culiacan, 580 miles (1,000 km) northwest of Mexico City.
Transport Director Martin Landeros told the state news agency Notimex the bus was carrying 83 workers on board, but its official maximum capacity was 46.
